title: Looking for some feedback from some D&D lovers!
author: RollForAI
selftext:
Hey r/aigamedev, I've been working on creating a D&D inspired platform where people can create and play fantasy campaigns. I have a Game Master AI that can read and update the map, inventory, and quests. I'm just entering the first public release today and I'd love some feedback on what works, what doesnt, and what features should be added first.

  
Here's some more info on the landing page: [https://www.rollforai.com/](https://www.rollforai.com/) 

  
If anyone is interested in trying it and letting me know what they think shoot me a DM and I'll get you an invite :)
